body_html: @amirad @thornet @epilepticrabbit reading over Basics I again https://teach.mozilla.org/clubs/curriculum/ we should have included make-a-meme. Needs more scaffolding between writing the web and participating on the web. I found using the make-a-meme remix to be a good way to teach basic CSS and HTML. It fits nicely after Hacking the News. There are also easy no-fi and lo-fi options.
